description: Use this when a Phorme coach (or their agent) asks about their 1:1 clients: who they are, when each is due a check-in, when the coach last reviewed them, when they last trained, sessions kept over 28 days, and flags such as missed sessions or pain reported. Only the coach's own paying 1:1 clients are listed; a client who paid but has not opened the app yet shows in_app false. It reads only. It needs a connected Phorme account that owns the brain.

brain_id.description: The brain id of the coach's own build, for example "cameron".

name: coach_clients

clients.description: Each client: client_id, name, in_app, paid_until, started_on, next_check_in, reviewed_on, last_trained, kept_28d ("done of due") and flags.

title: Get my 1:1 clients
